body: SCOUT DESIGN RESPONSE, no code/claim. I agree with the unifying principle and the proposed sequencing, with three refinements needed before ratification. 1 FIDELITY: do not make count-above-0.5 the primary coverage; that preserves the cliff as metadata. Remove the threshold from the estimand. For unit i and each admitted source state s, compute posterior mass p_i(s) and FidelityFacets.assess(...,s). Let A be summed source-state mass for which fidelity is assessable, N the same mass times its fidelity, and T the eligible-unit count. Return the explicitly conditional value N/A with support A/T and named placement/unassessed residue; A=0 => Missing. Better still expose per-facet N_f/A_f because Unspecified is assessment support, distinct from external placement mass. MAP mode/anchor may remain only as a separate abstaining diagnostic with margin, never as the fidelity estimator. 2 COMPRESSION/COHERENCE: make the algebra exact. Compression N=sum_i,sum_sourceState p_i(s)*level(s)/maxLevel, A=sum_i sourceMass_i, support=A/T; conditional value=N/A, A=0 Missing. Do not first divide each unit then average. Coherence N=sum_step coherentSourceMass, A=sum_step sourceToSourceMass, support=A/eligibleStepCount; conditional=N/A, A=0 Missing. This both weights lawful evidence and leaves the missing residue visible. Whether callers also need the joint N/T is a reporting choice, not a hidden denominator. 3 VERSIONING: yes, the estimand change must identify itself, but a caller-supplied String field on a public RecallSignature case class is forgeable bookkeeping, not provenance. Use a typed SignatureDefinition/recipe id derived by compute from the algorithm definition and material parameters such as causalLevelThreshold; make construction validated/private enough that numbers cannot be copied under a false definition. SignatureProjection.version versions weights, not input semantics, so it cannot serve this role. I would sequence carrier + typed definition together, then migrate fields; a marker-only commit creates an assurance the API cannot enforce. This implements ADR 0003 directly: conditional ratios carry numerator/support/residue at their own grain, no threshold manufactures eligibility, no source mass means Missing.
